name: Stat File
description: Return metadata for a path under a configured filesystem root. Reports whether the path exists, its type (file/directory/symlink/other), size in bytes, last-modified time (epoch millis), the root's read-only flag, and, for an entry in DLFS, any application metadata set with file_set_metadata.
creator: Covia

root.description: Configured root name; omit for a canonical DLFS path

path.description: Path relative to root or a canonical DLFS path

metadata.description: The DLFS entry's application metadata; absent when it has none
